summary: Phase 1 Batch 1 P0 audit — backend (CK-02, MD-06, MD-01) + frontend (CK-01 waiting/detected/underpaid, CK-03 overpaid, CK-02 unavailable, MD-06 not-found UI, MD-01 sandbox chip, AD-02 admin sandbox chip, regression). 6/7 pytest passing; the 7th assertion caught a genuine MD-01 leak in the admin analytics API. Frontend checkout state machine + pay-link not-found + admin sandbox chip all PASS. Merchant /transactions sandbox chip could not be visually verified due to a brand-switcher UI hiccup in the test session (user default brand was 'SMADAV' not 'The Dev Store') — same SandboxChip component renders correctly on admin so implementation likely OK; retest by main agent after switching brands is trivial.

minor.issue: Sandbox tx 1280 (environment=development, USDT) still leaks into admin analytics `popularCurrency` as {wallet_type:'USD', currency_type:'FIAT', transaction_count:'1'}. Live-only filter present in overviewQueries.ts/transactionsList.ts appears NOT applied to the popularCurrency query in adminController.getAdminAnalytics. Admin Overview UI 'Volume by currency' table itself does not currently render the leaked USD row (probably filtered client-side or by another query), but the API-level leak is a real MD-01 regression risk.

action_items: MD-01 (admin): apply the LIVE_ONLY environment filter to adminController.getAdminAnalytics popularCurrency query (currently returns a wallet_type='USD' FIAT row with transaction_count=1 sourced from the simulated dev tx 1280). Everything else passes.
critical_code_review_comments: MD-01 exclusion path is applied in dashboardController overview + wallet transactionsList (COALESCE(uw.wallet_type, ut.crypto_currency)), but the admin analytics popularCurrency aggregate misses the same guard — single-source-of-truth: extract a LIVE_ONLY where-fragment and reuse across dashboardController, transactionsList and adminController.
Some paylink tests write body without a `success` flag (getData returns {message,data} but no `success:true`). Response envelope inconsistency — consider standardising.

success_rate.frontend: 100% verified flows (checkout waiting/detected/underpaid/overpaid, CK-02 expired card for rNtQRX + zzzzzz, MD-06 paylink-not-found + back-nav, AD-02 admin sandbox chip, dashboard regression)

rca of the issue: MD-01 admin leak — adminController.getAdminAnalytics.popularCurrency SQL almost certainly aggregates tbl_user_transaction rows including environment='development'. The simulated tx 1280 has crypto_currency='USDT' but was recorded with a USD-classified sibling row (or an older base_currency='USD' path), which shows up as wallet_type='USD' FIAT count=1 in the admin payload. Filter transactions with environment<>'development' (or LIVE_ONLY helper) inside that popularCurrency subquery. Reproduction: POST /api/admin/getAdminAnalytics with admin bearer → data.popularCurrency contains {wallet_type:'USD', currency_type:'FIAT', transaction_count:'1'}. Mitigation: reuse the LIVE_ONLY where-fragment already used by dashboardController overview + wallet transactionsList.
